2026–27 Winter Season · Japan

Ski & Snowboard
Instructor Recruitment

GlideX Snow Sports School is looking for qualified ski and snowboard instructors to join our team in Echigo-Yuzawa and Zao Onsen.

✉ Apply by email: info@glidex.netView details
RoleSki / Snowboard Instructor
Pay¥3,500–¥5,000 / hour
LocationsEchigo-Yuzawa / Zao
SeasonWinter 2026–27

Work when you teach.
Ride when you don’t.

This is an assignment-based seasonal instructor role—not a full-day standby position. When you have a lesson, you teach. When you don’t, your time is yours to train, ride and enjoy the mountain.

01

Flexible schedule

No lesson, no required on-site standby. Make the most of your days on snow.

02

Staff accommodation

Shared staff housing is available. Conditions and fees will be explained during the interview.

03

Instructor season pass

We provide the relevant instructor lift pass for your assigned resort.

04

Resort registration

GlideX arranges the required ski-school and resort access procedures.

Who we are looking for

Professional on lessons.
Passionate on snow.

✓

Recognized instructor qualificationA current ski or snowboard instructor certification from a recognized national or international body, such as CSIA/CASI, PSIA-AASI, BASI, NZSIA/SBINZ, SAJ/JSBA, or an equivalent organization.

✓

Right to work in JapanYou must hold—or be eligible to obtain—a status that permits paid work in Japan for the season, such as a Working Holiday visa or another appropriate residence status.

✓

Languages and serviceStrong communication skills and a safety-first, guest-focused attitude. English, Chinese and Japanese ability are all welcome.

✓

Season availabilityPriority may be given to applicants who can join for most or all of the winter season. Exact dates are discussed individually.

Two iconic winter bases.

Applicants may indicate a preferred location. Final assignment is discussed based on availability, qualifications, language skills and operational needs.

Niigata

Echigo-Yuzawa Area

Multiple ski resorts in and around the Yuzawa area.

Yamagata

Zao Onsen Ski Resort

One of Japan’s most distinctive mountain destinations.

中文招聘信息

招募 2026–27 雪季
单板／双板滑雪教练

GlideX Snow Sports School（GlideX 中文国际滑雪学校）现面向 2026–27 雪季招募滑雪教练，工作地点为越后汤泽地区各雪场及藏王温泉滑雪场。

薪资与工作方式

时薪 3,500–5,000 日元

具体时薪根据教练资质、教学经验、语言能力及面试结果确定。本职位采用按课程安排出勤的工作方式，并非要求教练整日在雪场固定待命。安排有课程时负责教学；没有课程时，可自由练习或滑行。

我们提供

  • 教练宿舍（住宿条件及费用将在面试时说明）
  • 工作雪场的教练季卡
  • 滑雪学校登记及雪场入场手续办理
  • 多语言、国际化的教练团队与工作环境

应聘条件

  • 持有受认可的单板或双板教练资格，例如 CSIA/CASI、PSIA-AASI、BASI、NZSIA/SBINZ、SAJ/JSBA 或其他同等资质
  • 已持有、或符合申请能够在日本合法从事有偿工作的签证／在留资格，例如 Working Holiday，或其他允许工作的在留资格
  • 重视安全，具备责任感、良好的沟通能力及服务意识
  • 可使用英语、中文或日语进行教学／沟通者欢迎申请
  • 能够参加大部分或整个雪季者优先，具体到岗时间可单独协商

申请方式

请将个人简历、教练资格证书、应聘项目（单板／双板）、希望工作地点、签证／在留资格情况及可工作日期发送至：info@glidex.net。邮件标题请注明“2026–27 教练应聘”。
